headline: Homebuilders Lead a Broad Tuesday Rally as Healthcare Lags
body_html:
Equities are comfortably in positive territory at midday Tuesday, with 359 stocks in our 544-name universe trading higher against 181 in the red. The tone is constructive and the gains are spread across the tape, though the advance is not without its soft patches. Homebuilders are out front with a sector gain of 2.06%, followed by Materials at 1.08% and Industrials at 0.87%. Healthcare is the lone sector in negative territory, off 0.32%, dragged by weakness in diagnostics and life-science tools names.

The standout mover of the session so far is Option Care Health, which has surged 32.8%, a dramatic intraday move that demands explanation into the close. Apogee Enterprises, a construction-glass specialist, has added 17.54%, and agricultural-sciences firm Corteva is up 11.46%. On the downside, storage names are under notable pressure — Seagate Technology has fallen 8.07% and Western Digital another 6.4% — suggesting a sector-specific rotation away from hardware storage.

Into the afternoon, traders will be watching whether homebuilder momentum holds and whether the storage selloff deepens or stabilizes. Oil prices are easing on reports of steady Middle East export flows and comfortable G7 stockpiles, which may keep Energy gains modest heading into Wednesday's session.

briefs.headline: Option Care Health Vaults More Than 32% in Mid-Session Trade
briefs.body: Option Care Health is the undisputed mover of the day, posting a 32.8% gain in afternoon trading. The healthcare-services company has offered no immediate catalyst through normal channels, making it a name to watch closely for any news flow before the closing bell.

briefs.headline: Storage Hardware Takes a Hit as Seagate and Western Digital Slide
briefs.body: Seagate Technology is down 8.07% and Western Digital has dropped 6.4%, making storage hardware the weakest industry pocket in Tuesday's session. The paired declines suggest investors may be rotating away from legacy storage on concerns about near-term demand or pricing dynamics.

briefs.headline: Oil Eases as Middle East Supply Fears Recede
briefs.body: Crude prices are slipping midday after reports indicated that Middle East export flows remain intact and G7 inventories are providing a sufficient buffer. The softer oil backdrop is keeping gains in the Energy sector to a modest 0.39%, even as the broader market rallies.

briefs.headline: Ciena Jumps 10% on Optical Networking Enthusiasm
briefs.body: Optical networking firm Ciena has climbed 10.2% in Tuesday trade, making it one of the session's cleaner breakout stories. The move points to renewed investor appetite for networking infrastructure, a theme that has been gaining traction alongside sustained data-center buildout expectations.

briefs.headline: Bank of England Official Warns Elevated UK Inflation Is Becoming Entrenched
briefs.body: A Bank of England policymaker signaled that high inflation has become embedded in the British economy, a hawkish signal that complicates the central bank's rate path. The remarks add to a cautious global macro backdrop that currency and fixed-income desks are monitoring Tuesday afternoon.

briefs.headline: Corteva Surges Over 11% as Agricultural Sector Gets a Lift
briefs.body: Corteva is among the session's strongest large-cap performers, advancing 11.46% and providing an outsized lift to the broader agricultural-sciences space. India's September fuel consumption rising 3.9% month-over-month adds a constructive demand signal to the commodity-linked backdrop underpinning the move.
